# Specialist Movers

> Auckland and Hamilton's premium moving company. House, furniture, piano, commercial, packing, storage, and exit cleaning. Founded 2023. Hundreds of 5-star Google reviews.

Specialist Movers (KB Logistics Limited) runs from bases in Auckland (Wairau Valley) and Hamilton. We service Auckland, the Waikato, and wider North Island moves. Trusted by Steinway and major Auckland music stores for piano relocations.

For the full reference — real prices, every FAQ, and every suburb — see llms-full.txt.

## Services

- House and home relocations (viewing-first quotes for three bedrooms and up)
- Furniture moving (single items, part loads, heavy and awkward pieces)
- Piano moving (upright, grand, storage, international shipping)
- Office and commercial relocations (SiteWise Gold certified)
- Professional packing (crew packs the day before move day)
- Exit cleaning (fixed-price tenancy cleans)
- Loading and unloading (when you drive and we lift)
- Hard-to-shift items (spa pools, safes, pool tables, kilns, balcony hoists)
- WINZ moving quotes (written quotes for assistance applications)
- Short-term, long-term, overnight, and in-transit storage
- International moving (sea and air freight)

## Pricing at a glance

All prices exclude GST.

- Auckland, two-person crew and truck: $120/hr on Tuesday (cheapest), $150 on Friday (dearest)
- Hamilton, two-person crew and truck: $140/hr on Tuesday, $150 other days
- Callout fee: $60 within ~23km of depot, $80 to 45km, $120 beyond
- Typical one-bedroom apartment: about $300. Three-bedroom house on a Friday: about $660
- Piano: uprights from $290, grands from $550, each with $2,000 cover included

## Insurance

Crews are licensed and insured and we carry $2,000,000 public liability. Household goods travel at owner's risk under the Contract and Commercial Law Act 2017, which is standard across the industry; transit cover can be arranged through our broker on request. Pianos carry $2,000 of cover as standard.
